bullets.title: Nighttime That's as Bright as Day
bullets.text: Harness the power of a 4K camera combined with MaxColor Vision technology. eufyCam S3 Pro captures exceptionally detailed surveillance footage in every frame, offering day-like image clarity even in ultra-low light conditions without the need for a spotlight.

bullets.title: Reliable Solar Power System
bullets.text: Experience peace of mind year-round with continuous, reliable security powered by SolarPlus 2.0 technology. Choose the built-in panel for streamlined efficiency or add an external panel to expand energy coverage. This system offers versatile mounting options and reliable backup power for continuous security.(includes backup solar panel).

bullets.title: Radar-Powered Detection Alerts Only What Matters
bullets.text: The dual motion detection system, combining radar and passive infrared (PIR), accurately identifies human movement and reduces false alerts by 99%, guaranteeing that alerts are only triggered by major security events in specified areas.

bullets.title: Local Security, No Monthly Fee
bullets.text: 16GB of on-device storage and up to 16TB of expandable storage without monthly fees, HomeBase S380 equips your devices with self-learning AI for intelligent management and facilitates effortless control over group settings, keeps your privacy securely in your hands.

bullets.title: Compatible with
bullets.text: HomeKit, Alexa, and other voice assistant. (The video footage will be 1080P resolution when using HomeKit.

bullets.title: Constant Care with Hybrid Monitoring
bullets.text: Check in on your baby from anywhere at home, with or without Wi-Fi. Whether you're at work or traveling, stay connected through the app and share access with up to 5 family members for extra support.

bullets.title: 4K UHD Resolution
bullets.text: to See Every Detail, Day and Night: With a 330° pan, 60° tilt, and 8× zoom, you'll catch every corner and facial detail, even seeing their chest rise and fall in the dark thanks to crystal-clear night vision. If you have twins, monitor both with two feeds on one split screen.

bullets.title: Travel Made Easy with Plug-In or Battery Power
bullets.text: Powered by a 5,000mAh battery, this camera goes anywhere with your baby. Move it around at home or take it to your summer cabin or hotel for seamless care during trips and gatherings. You can always count on it, even during outages.

bullets.title: Sleep Tight with Noiseless, Smart Monitoring
bullets.text: Get ready for some well-deserved rest. It comes with active noise reduction tech to cut background noise by 20 dB and alerts you to your baby's cries, room temperature changes, and loud noises. Plus, 24/7 recording in the app helps you uncover any sleep issues for your little one.

bullets.title: Full Privacy and Security in One Switch
bullets.text: Toggle the switch to cut off Wi-Fi for a secure, private local connection. With RSA-1024 and AES-128 encryption, hackers and unauthorized users are kept at bay. Every recording is protected with a unique key and saved to your local SD card for absolute peace of mind.

bullets.title: Note
bullets.text: SD card not included.

bullets.title: Pure Bass That Never Stops
bullets.text: soundcore H30i wireless on-ear headphones feature 40mm oversized drivers to consistently deliver powerful audio, alongside enhanced pure bass, to bring your music to life.

bullets.title: Long-Lasting Playtime
bullets.text: Never stop the music with an impressive 70-hour battery life on a single charge. Experience lightning-fast charging with soundcore H30i, giving 4 hours of playtime on a quick 5-minute charge.

bullets.title: Lightweight and Comfortable
bullets.text: soundcore H30i on-ear wireless headphones are ideal for those longer listening sessions at only 183g. Crafted with soft, detachable earcups and an ergonomic shape, ear fatigue is a thing of the past.

bullets.title: Seamless and Stable Connection
bullets.text: Experience the best of both worlds with Bluetooth 5.3. Whether listening to music or watching a film, seamlessly switch between devices to pick up an incoming call or watch a quick video.

bullets.title: App Customization
bullets.text: Create a totally personalized listening experience with the soundcore app. Customize your own EQ settings or choose from preset options, enjoy relaxing white noise, and more

bullets.title: Stay Aware, Stay Comfortable
bullets.text: AeroFit 2 open-ear headphones offer all-day comfort with soft materials and a non-invasive, double-curved design, keeping you attuned to the world while enjoying music.

bullets.title: A Perfect Fit for Every Ear
bullets.text: soundcore's innovative 4-level adjustable ear hooks ensure a comfortable fit tailored to over 99% of ear shapes and sizes.

bullets.title: Close to the Ear Canal for 2x Deeper Bass
bullets.text: Adjustable ear hooks bring the sound closer, doubling the bass output of non-adjustable buds. A maximum boost of 7.5dB delivers richer, more powerful beats. Note: Data from the soundcore lab.

bullets.title: Free Al Translation
bullets.text: Supports 100 languages with real-time response and high accuracy. From tropical vacations to global conferences, stay in the loop wherever life takes you. Note: Ensure the soundcore app is version 3.8.7 or later and the earbud firmware is updated to the latest version.

bullets.title: Rich Sound
bullets.text: Enjoy deep bass, clear mids, and vivid treble, fueled by 20mm × 11.5mm racetrack drivers and BassTurbo acoustics. It also supports Bluetooth 5.4 and the LDAC codec for stable, Hi-Res audio transmission.

bullets.title: Wireless Recharge, Long Playtime
bullets.text: Place the case on a wireless charger for a tangle-free recharge. Get up to 10 hours of music on a single charge, extendable to 42 hours with the case.

bullets.text: This USB C charger cable is meticulously crafted for seamless use with any USB-C device, delivering reliable and efficient charging. (Kindly note: it does not support video output.)

bullets.text: Charge 1.5× faster with highly efficient monocrystalline cells and a powerful surface that traps sunlight.
